notes.title: New update.
notes.notes:
This update brings some heavy balancing to the difficulty levels. While there are still 3 levels to choose from, after heavy testing and community feedback, we have found a perfect balance between difficulty and fun. Enjoy :)

Additionally we fixed the level that was nearly unsolvable.

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
This new update solves a number of issues that were reported to us.

- Levitating, uncollectable shoes
- One of the achivements was not always toggling correctly. 
- levels in world 2 are unlocked similiarly to world 1. There are always 3 levels that you can choose from. 

Sorry for these issues and have a pleasant game ;)
